## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自动化技能（`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`）新增两句：① `notify` 节——通知里要印选项标签，写在邮件模板里用 `{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}`（按每个收件人的语言印），`option` 只有邮件模板认（行内 `title` / `message` 拒收），⛔ 不用 `templateData` 里的 `label()`（每次运行只算一次、在收件人扇出之前）；② 「Assignment rules」节——`assignTo: { type: 'user' }` 指定的人只在仍是该组织的在职成员时才拥有记录，否则记录无主落地。eval 15 新增通知用例。文档页 `automation/queues-and-assignment-rules` 的「Declare an assignment rule」节新增组织自建规则（`sys_assignment_rule`）：先于应用声明的规则求值、按 `sort_order` 再按名字、首个命中生效、组织规则读不到就不路由、`user` 目标的在职成员规则、保存时校验哪些字段。
- 为什么改：两个上游半边都已合入（#30727 + #30781 的邮件 `option` 格式化器；#30760 的组织自建分派规则），技能和文档还没教，照技能写通知的 agent 会去 `templateData` 里写 `label()`，要么保存被拒，要么所有收件人同一种语言；读文档的作者仍以为分派规则只有声明式、`user` 目标永远拥有记录。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本、eval 夹具、文档页与棘轮上限行（6449 → 6448，按实测锁定），不碰运行时；回滚 = revert 本 PR。为付账删掉的三处（见下文 Deletions）各有别处承载。
- 先看：① `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `notify` 节新段与「Assignment rules」改行（措辞是否与 `main` 上的渲染行为一致）；② `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` 新增三段（与 `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts` 头注释逐条对照）；③ 删掉的「CRM Automation Blueprint」节。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 预期 `6448 tokens (ceiling 6448; headroom 0)`；`pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` 预期退出 0。
- 需要你做的：Tier H（`skills/**`）——席位契约复审通过后，由 os-zhuang 批准/入队。

## What changes

**#30731 — `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, `notify` section.** One paragraph after the `notify` config block: an option label in a notice is `{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}` in the mail `template`, printed in each recipient's language; `option` is mail-only and refused in an inline `title` / `message`; never `label()` in `templateData`, which is evaluated once per run, before fan-out. Read from `main`: `packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts` (`MAIL_ONLY_FORMATTERS = ['option']`, `optionFieldReference`: bare `object.field`), `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` (the label table is built per send in the recipient's locale), `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts` (`templateData` is a value-slot map resolved once per run; the `template` locale is resolved per recipient after fan-out), `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` (`label()` is the formula-field macro).

**#30731 — `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json`.** Eval 15: a stalled-opportunity e-mail whose subject shows the stage label in each recipient's language. `must_contain`: `option:opportunity.stage`, `template`, `once per run`; `must_not_contain`: `source: 'label(` and `| label` (the two wrong spellings a right answer never writes). Appended by splicing before the closing bracket, so no other case is reformatted.

**#30826 — `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, "Assignment rules".** The `assignTo: { type: 'user', value: 'ID' }` sentence now reads "names one owner, who holds the row only while an active member of its organization (else ownerless)". Read from `packages/objectql/src/assignment-rules.ts` (`organizationMemberStanding`: a `sys_member` row and no ban in force; the engine asks it of every user target at insert, declared rules included) and `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/assignment-rule-hooks.ts` (the save guard asks the same predicate).

**#30826 — `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`, "2. Declare an assignment rule".** Three paragraphs after "The rule writes `owner_id` …": the active-member rule for a `user` target; the organization's own `sys_assignment_rule` records (Setup → Assignment Rules, `manage_platform_settings`; one rule with one entry; `active`), one namespace by name with the declared rules (mirroring the page's `sys_queue` paragraph), evaluated **first** by `sort_order` then `name` with the declared `assignmentRules` as the fallback (the activation ledger has no organization column), first match wins, a failed read of the organization's rules routes nothing; and what the save guard refuses. One checklist bullet. Pages checked for existing coverage before writing (maintainer rule, no duplicate sections): `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx` (declared rules and `sys_queue` only), `content/docs/automation/index.mdx` (one summary line, declared rules), `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` (the `queue` approver), `content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx` (queue recipients and `current_user.queues`), `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx` (release-owned); `content/docs/references/api/metadata.mdx` and `references/kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx` list the `assignment_rule` metadata type only. No page mentions `sys_assignment_rule`; the generated references carry no page for the object.

**Changeset** `.changeset/30731-automation-skill-notify-label-and-org-assignment-rules.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, naming both cards.

**Ratchet** `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the SKILL.md row moves DOWN 6449 → 6448, re-locked at the measurement (headroom 0).

### Deletions that pay for the two additions (same file)

1. **The `## CRM Automation Blueprint` section** (three lines + rule): the `src/flows/*.flow.ts` → `src/flows/index.ts` → `defineStack({ flows })` layout is carried by `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` ("Use barrel exports", `import * as flows from './src/flows'` into `defineStack({ flows: Object.values(flows) })`), and the skill's frontmatter already names `*.flow.ts` as the trigger to load it.
2. **"When to Use This Skill"**: the clause "that route a new record to a queue or a person" restated the section heading `## Assignment rules — route a new record to a queue or a person`; "scheduled automation" restated "Flows (… scheduled)" three words earlier.
3. **"Verify your work"**: the line "In a scaffolded project: `npm run validate`." is carried by objectstack-formula's Verify section ("`npm run validate` in a scaffolded project"), which this skill names for CEL validation at its top.

Each surviving sentence of the trimmed paragraphs was re-read against `main`; nothing deleted has no other home. No line was re-wrapped to win room.

### Neighbour overlap

Seat 1's draft PR #30831 (#30805) edits `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` at lines 295 and 306–320 (the assignment-rule example's names and the `approvers` line) and eval cases 3, 7, 9, 11, 12 of `flows-triggers-approvals.json`. This PR's "Assignment rules" hunk changes the two lines directly above its `approvers` line, so whichever lands second resolves one adjacent-line conflict there; the `notify` paragraph, the two deletions and eval 15 (appended at the file's end) are outside its hunks. `origin/main` was merged and the ratchet re-measured before each push.

## Acceptance notes

- The skill line keeps the `option` argument spelling to the bare `object.field` form `main` accepts; the quoted, marked-path and one-sided forms are refused by `optionFieldReference` and not taught.
- `label()` stays taught where it belongs (objectstack-formula, a formula field's display in the reader's locale); the automation skill now only says where it is wrong.
- Out of scope, noted and not filed (class: none of a/b/c — read-only observation): the docs page's `## See also` points at the generated `assignment-rule` schema reference; no generated page exists for the `sys_assignment_rule` object, so the new prose names its columns inline.
- First commit's author is spelled as the fleet bot (a local `-c user.name` override); later commits use the container's default `Claude` identity. The squash on landing rewrites it either way.
